revision: The audio system shall provide an Easy Listening sound mode that produces a moderate sound impression and is suitable for relaxed long-term listening, as verified by a documented listening test with defined acceptance criteria for both attributes.

label: defect
original: [SRC004d] It is possible to miss some restarts in 3S seconds operation mode because the rail pressure goes down if the stop mode lasts very long and there is not enough time to raise it up for restart.
revision: [SRC004d] In 3S seconds operation mode, the system shall permit one or more restarts to be missed when the stop-mode duration causes the rail pressure to fall below the restart pressure threshold and the time available before the restart is less than the rail-pressure build-up time required to reach the restart pressure threshold.

label: defect
original: Description: The precharging time for the on-board charger is too long.
revision: The precharging time for the on-board charger shall not exceed the maximum precharging time defined in the applicable on-board charger specification, measured under the conditions specified therein.

label: defect
original: The OBC shall monitor the Precharging functionality for being too long.
revision: The OBC shall monitor the duration of the Precharging functionality and shall indicate an overlong precharge condition when that duration exceeds the specified maximum precharge duration.

label: defect
original: Description: The precharging time of the high-voltage on-board electrical system is too long.
revision: The high-voltage on-board electrical system precharging time, measured from the start of precharging until the system reaches its ready state, shall not exceed the maximum precharging time specified in the applicable system specification.

label: defect
original: The time dependence is distinguishing between short term and long term loads including a blending algorithm in between.
revision: The system shall distinguish between short-term and long-term loads according to specified time-dependence criteria and shall apply a specified blending algorithm between the short-term and long-term load calculations.

label: defect
original: The fading between peak and long term current threshold must be based on the specification of the components inside the battery system.
revision: The transition (fading) between the peak current threshold and the long-term current threshold shall be determined using the specifications of the components contained in the battery system and shall be documented with traceability to the specific component specifications used.

label: defect
original: After relaxation the cell voltage is measured two times with a sufficiently long time interval in between.
revision: After relaxation, the cell voltage shall be measured exactly twice, with the time interval between the two measurements being at least the minimum interval defined in the test procedure.

label: defect
original: A dynamic behaviour of blending from short to long and vice versa is strongly recommended.
revision: The system should dynamically blend from short to long and from long to short.

label: defect
original: Further it calculates the current charge level of the battery by integration and determines the SOC by the quiescent voltage if the standby time is long enough.
revision: The system shall calculate the battery state of charge (SOC) by integrating battery current over time, and shall determine the SOC from the quiescent battery voltage when the standby time is greater than or equal to the configured minimum standby duration for quiescent-voltage measurement.

label: defect
original: It is irrelevant how long the button is kept pressed.
revision: The system’s response to a button press shall be independent of the duration for which the button is pressed.

label: defect

revision: For detections originating from road-border objects such as guide posts, the system shall not determine whether the object can be overrun or underrun unless the object has been observed for at least the minimum observation time specified in the system specification; the system shall not assume that this minimum observation time is available for such detections.

label: defect

revision: After the vehicle has exited a tunnel, the signal states TUNNEL, TUNNEL_SENSITIV, and CARPARK shall not remain active after the vehicle has traveled 40 m from the tunnel exit if no road curve is present; if a road curve is present, these states may remain active beyond 40 m to avoid missed detection.

revision: The driver shall provide test pulses that enable detection of otherwise undetectable failures when a power stage is held in a defined state for an extended period.

revision: The real-time clock shall support scheduling one or more events over a time period that exceeds the maximum period supported by the existing implementation, without requiring intermediate wake-ups between scheduled events.

label: defect
original: If the parking time is longer the calculation has to be stopped.
revision: If the parking duration exceeds the defined maximum parking duration, the parking-time calculation shall stop.

revision:
The Head Unit (HUH) shall perform the following functions for the Car-to-Infrastructure application:
1. The HUH shall collect data from the vehicle network, pre-process it using algorithms provided by the OEM, and transmit the resulting pre-processed data to the OEM Vehicle Backend (OEMVB) at a configurable interval defined by parameters $T_{min}$ (minutes) or $D_{min}$ (meters).
2. The HUH shall receive notifications regarding dangerous spots from the OEMVB.
3. Upon receipt, the HUH shall validate each notification for relevance to the current driver by performing map-matching of the spot location against the vehicle's current position.
4. If a notification is deemed relevant, the HUH shall present the information on the Head Unit Human-Machine Interface (HMI) and/or the instrument cluster.

revision: The Charge Coupler Interface Connector (CCIC), Control Pilot, and Proximity detection system shall maintain functional integrity and prevent hazardous energy release during a short-circuit fault to the AC supply line for a duration of at least 10 seconds, provided that an upstream Type A Residual Current Device (RCD) with a rated residual operating current ($I_{\Delta n}$) of 30 mA and a circuit breaker successfully detect the fault condition and open the circuit within their specified maximum tripping times.

label: ok
original: Short circuit of each pin for 60 s both at ground and at UB.
revision: For each electrical pin, apply a short-circuit fault condition to ground and to the upper voltage rail (UB) sequentially, maintaining each condition for a duration of exactly 60 seconds, with no more than a 1-second interval between the end of one test and the start of the next.

label: ok
original: All contacts / pins on the Charge Coupler Interface Connector shall be tested to short circuits to the AC supply line.
revision: The Charge Coupler Interface Connector shall undergo a short-circuit test where each contact and pin is electrically connected to the AC supply line, and the system shall demonstrate no malfunction or damage under this condition.

label: ok
original: This test verifies the OBC 's immunity to short circuits in the 12 V vehicle electrical system where it is feasible that a short circuit can occur in the wiring or at the OBC lines.
revision: The On-Board Charger (OBC) shall maintain functional safety and prevent hazardous outputs when exposed to a short-circuit fault within the 12 V vehicle electrical system, including faults occurring in the wiring harness or at the OBC input/output terminals, provided such a fault is electrically feasible.

label: ok
original: The interlock control logic (IL-logic) as per Fig. 5-2 shall be designed so that a short circuit between the interlock lines can be detected.
revision: The Interlock Control Logic (IL-logic) shall detect and signal a fault condition if an electrical short circuit occurs between any two interlock lines, provided the short circuit resistance is less than 10 Ω at operating temperature.

label: ok
original: In the event of such a short circuit, the interlock CAN message shall be sent by an HV component.
revision: Upon detection of a high-voltage short circuit condition within the system, the High-Voltage (HV) component responsible for monitoring that specific fault shall transmit an Interlock Control Area Network (CAN) message containing the "Short Circuit" diagnostic code to the Vehicle Control Unit within 10 milliseconds of fault detection.

label: ok
original: A short circuit shall be detected in an HV component if the short circuit occurred in the signal connector or between the interlock lines that are routed between the signal driver circuit and this component.
revision: The system shall detect a short-circuit fault within 10 milliseconds when such a fault occurs on any interlock line connecting the signal driver circuit to the high-voltage (HV) component or at the associated signal connector, provided the fault results in a current exceeding 5 amperes.

label: ok
original: The monitoring of the interlock circuit for a short circuit is an additional supervision of the interlock circuit.
revision: The system shall detect and signal a fault condition within the interlock circuit if a short circuit occurs between any two conductors, ensuring that this detection constitutes an independent supervisory function distinct from the primary interlock logic.

label: ok
original: Intention of mode `` LOCKED '' is a basic self protection of the DC / DC converter in case of technical problems, e.g. short output circuit, internal voltage measurement break down etc.
revision: The DC/DC converter shall automatically transition to the "LOCKED" operating mode upon detection of any fault condition, including but not limited to an output short circuit or a failure in the internal voltage measurement circuitry.

label: ok
original: The LBC shall be self protected for over current and short circuit, in case of over current requested by load, the LBC shall limit the output current to its max output current for max duration (TBD), then disable the output for self protection.
revision: The Load Break Controller (LBC) shall detect an overcurrent condition caused by a load request and respond as follows: if the detected current exceeds the maximum rated output current, the LBC shall limit the output current to the maximum rated output current for a duration of [TBD] seconds; upon expiration of this duration, the LBC shall disable the output to enter a self-protected state.

label: ok
original: This test verifies the SDC 's immunity to short circuits in the I / O singnal lines where it is feasible that a short circuit can occur in the wiring or at the SDC lines.
revision: The System Design Controller (SDC) shall maintain functional safety and prevent hazardous states when exposed to a short circuit on any input or output signal line, provided such a fault is physically realizable within the defined system architecture and wiring environment.

label: ok
original: - to look for best position of cells and / or the battery system in case of a crash situation (electrical safety, prevention of short circuits, loss of substances, heat up, etc.)
revision: The vehicle battery management system shall automatically determine and execute an optimal relocation strategy for individual cells or the entire battery pack within 50 milliseconds following detection of a crash event exceeding 8 g deceleration, ensuring that all electrical connections are secured to prevent short circuits, containment integrity is maintained to prevent substance leakage, and thermal runaway propagation is mitigated.

label: ok
original: Especially in crash situation, vehicle system or battery malfunction and / or internal or electrical short circuit.
revision: The vehicle control system shall detect a crash event, battery malfunction, or an internal/electrical short circuit within 10 milliseconds of occurrence and initiate the appropriate safety response without loss of critical functionality.

label: ok
original: The battery design shall mitigate cell damage and internal short circuit.
revision: The battery design shall prevent cell damage and internal short circuits under all defined operating conditions, including maximum charge/discharge rates, extreme ambient temperatures (−40°C to +60°C), and mechanical abuse events as specified in the test matrix, with no occurrence of thermal runaway or hazardous leakage during verification testing.

label: ok
original: Furthermore the cell block and all internal connections must stay intact so far, that no short circuit, isolation failure, leakage or any other critical event occurs.
revision: The cell block and all internal connections shall remain structurally and electrically intact under specified operating conditions such that no short circuit, isolation failure, leakage current exceeding the defined threshold, or any other critical safety event occurs.

label: ok
original: The cell block has to include an additional switch-off circuit which protects the battery system against short circuit current.
revision: The cell block shall incorporate a switch-off circuit that interrupts the electrical path within 5 milliseconds of detecting a short-circuit condition, thereby limiting the fault current flowing through the battery system to less than 10 amperes.

label: ok
original: There has to be included a fuse, which protects the battery system against short circuit current.
revision: The battery system shall include a fuse rated for [insert specific rating] amperes that interrupts fault currents exceeding [insert threshold] amperes within [insert time duration] seconds under all specified operating conditions.

label: ok
original: For shut off in the situation of short circuit in the battery or the hv-net, the contractor may implement an additional fuse.
revision: The system shall automatically disconnect power via a dedicated fuse upon detection of a short circuit within the battery or high-voltage network; the specific fuse rating and installation location are defined by the contractor's design documentation.

label: ok
original: If a fuse is used for shut off of a short circuit, the fuse shall be located between cell 17 and cell 18 to ensure a disconnection of the half block of the battery.
revision: If a fuse is employed to disconnect a short-circuit current within a battery module, it shall be installed in series between Cell 17 and Cell 18; verification shall confirm that this configuration electrically isolates the sub-module containing Cells 1 through 17 from the remainder of the battery pack (Cells 18 through N) upon fuse operation.

label: ok
original: - Short circuit behaviour must be proofed on max. number of cells not divided by shut-of circuit.
revision: The system shall demonstrate that short-circuit protection is verified for a maximum of [N] connected cells, where N represents the highest number of cells in any single series string prior to the activation of the shutdown circuit mechanism.

label: ok
original: The main contactors must open under short circuit condition at least for one situation.
revision: The main contactors shall open within 50 milliseconds of a short-circuit fault occurring on any phase, as verified by applying a defined short-circuit current to the system and confirming full disengagement of all contacts.

label: ok
original: Otherwise, the main contactors open at over currents and in case of short circuit, the fuse is designed to interrupt the TV path and after actuate, the main contactors must open.
revision: If an overcurrent condition or a short circuit occurs in the TV path, the fuse shall interrupt the current flow; upon successful fuse operation, the main contactors shall automatically open within 10 milliseconds to isolate the fault.

label: ok
original: Measurement range might by higher depending on the detection of short circuits.
revision: The measurement range shall be dynamically adjusted to a value greater than the nominal maximum if a short circuit is detected; otherwise, it shall remain at the nominal maximum.

label: ok
original: Driver feedback (on / off) and short circuit input are required for diagnostics.
revision: The system shall provide a configurable driver feedback signal state (ON/OFF) and accept a short-circuit input signal to enable diagnostic functions, where the diagnostic logic is triggered upon detection of either condition.

label: ok
original: The battery supplier has to develop a concept for the short circuit switch off case regarding the main contactor and fuse capabilities.
revision: The battery supplier shall define a design concept demonstrating that the main contactor and fuse combination can safely interrupt fault currents within 10 milliseconds under all specified short-circuit conditions, ensuring no damage to components or hazardous energy release.

label: ok
original: The contractor has to implement a system, which assures a shut off of the battery system in the case of a short circuit.
revision: The system shall automatically disconnect the battery terminals from the load within 10 milliseconds upon detection of a short-circuit current exceeding 50 amperes, ensuring that the voltage across the load drops below 2 volts.

label: ok
original: The additional measurement range for short circuit / overcurrent detection shall be 500 ampere.
revision: The system shall detect and measure short-circuit or overcurrent events within a range of 0 to 500 amperes (AC RMS) with an accuracy of ±[insert specified percentage]% when tested under conditions defined in [insert reference standard/test procedure].

label: ok
original: The additional measurement range for short circuit / overcurrent detection shall be greater than 250 ampere to 500 ampere.
revision: The system shall detect and measure short-circuit or overcurrent events within a continuous range of 250 A to 500 A, with measurement accuracy maintained within ±[specified tolerance]% across the entire range.

label: ok
original: In case that the interlock loop is open the BMS shall distinguish the following error conditions: signal loop interrupted or no HVIL signal short circuit against LV+ short circuit against vehicle ground
revision: The Battery Management System (BMS) shall detect and classify an open interlock loop condition into one of the following three distinct states: 1) Signal loop interruption, 2) High Voltage Interlock Loop (HVIL) signal short circuit to Low Voltage positive (LV+), or 3) HVIL signal short circuit to vehicle ground.

label: ok
original: The cell or battery to be tested shall be temperature stabilized so that its external case temperature reaches 55 ± 2°C and then the cell or battery shall be subjected to a short circuit condition with a total external resistance of less than 0.1 ohm at 55 ± 2 °C.
revision: The test specimen shall be placed in a thermal environment capable of maintaining an external case temperature between 53°C and 57°C for a duration sufficient to achieve thermal equilibrium, as verified by a calibrated sensor with an uncertainty no greater than ±0.5°C; immediately upon verification that the external case temperature is within the range of 53°C to 57°C, a short circuit shall be applied using an external resistance measured and confirmed to be less than 0.1 Ω at the time of application.

label: ok
original: This short circuit condition is continued for at least one hour after the cell or battery external case temperature has returned to 55 ± 2°C.
revision: The system shall maintain a short-circuit condition for a duration of at least 60 minutes, commencing only after the external case temperature of the cell or battery has stabilized within the range of 53°C to 57°C (i.e., 55°C ± 2°C).

label: ok
original: Short circuit of battery system with 100 % SOC.
revision: The battery management system shall detect a short-circuit condition within the high-voltage battery pack when the State of Charge (SOC) is greater than or equal to 99% and initiate an appropriate safety response within 5 milliseconds.

label: ok
original: Short circuit of five centrally adjacent modules of a unit @ 100 % SOC.
revision: The system shall withstand a short-circuit fault applied simultaneously across five centrally adjacent modules of the battery unit at 100% State of Charge (SOC) without experiencing thermal runaway, fire, or explosion for a duration of 30 seconds.

label: ok
original: Short circuit tests for level sensors (e.g. washer fluid, coolant) have to be possible in the fill up operating conditions
revision: The system shall allow short-circuit testing of level sensors (including washer fluid and coolant sensors) while the vehicle is in the fueling state, where the fuel filler flap is open and the refueling process is active.

label: ok
original: Figure: Short circuit current behavior of a Li-Ion cell or battery (for information)
revision: The system shall provide a graphical representation illustrating the short-circuit current behavior of a Li-ion cell or battery, including the time-dependent decay of current from the initial peak to the thermal runaway threshold.

label: ok
original: This may be done by shut of by the component contactor for low short circuit currents and fuse for high short circuit currents.
revision: The system shall disconnect the faulted circuit by operating the component contactor for short-circuit currents below [Insert Threshold] amperes and by operating a fuse for short-circuit currents at or above [Insert Threshold] amperes, where the operation time shall not exceed [Insert Time Limit] milliseconds.

label: ok
original: Short circuit tests for level sensors (e.g. washer fluid, coolant) shall be possible under fill up operating conditions.
revision: The level sensor system shall successfully complete a short-circuit test without functional degradation or safety hazard when operated under full-fill conditions, defined as the sensor detecting 100% of the specified fluid volume within the designated reservoir.

label: ok
original: The purpose of the HV fuse is to ensure overall safety in case of short circuit events or overcurrent within the HV circuit.
revision: The high-voltage (HV) fuse shall interrupt the fault current within 10 milliseconds when a short circuit occurs between any two HV conductors or between an HV conductor and ground, provided the fault current exceeds 5 kA at the fuse location.

label: ok
original: The fuse has to safely cut off short circuit currents with full consideration of turn-off overvoltages.
revision: The fuse shall interrupt any fault current exceeding its rated breaking capacity within the specified time-current characteristic curve, ensuring that the resulting transient overvoltage across the terminals does not exceed 1.5 times the system nominal voltage (1.5 × Un) under all defined short-circuit conditions.

label: ok
original: For calculating and / or measuring the overvoltage during turn-off, inductivities of 50µH and maximum short circuit currents of 3500 ampere shall be taken into account.
revision: The system shall calculate and measure the overvoltage generated during turn-off under conditions where the inductance is 50 µH and the maximum short-circuit current is 3500 A.

label: ok
original: Faults (delivery interruptions, short circuits to ground or power) must be separately recognized and stored in every operating state (e.g. activated / not activated) on all inputs and outputs.
revision: The system shall detect, classify, and store distinct fault events—including delivery interruptions, short circuits to ground, and short circuits to power—for each individual input and output channel across all defined operating states (activated and deactivated). For every detected fault event, the system must record a unique timestamp, the specific fault type, the affected channel identifier, and the current operating state; these records shall be retained in non-volatile memory until explicitly cleared or overwritten by a new event.

label: ok
original: The save condition of the electric drive system in form of the low-side or the high-side active short circuit (AKS) has to be ensured also in low condition of the low voltage system in the range of 3 volts ... 6 volts (operation of the main controller is in this low voltage range not necessary)
revision: The electric drive system shall maintain a safe state defined as either a low-side or high-side active short circuit (AKS) when the low-voltage supply rail is between 3 V and 6 V, regardless of whether the main controller is operational within this voltage range.

label: ok
original: The PEB shall be able to provide a minimum of continuous 225 ampere short circuit current of electric machine via lower and / or upper AKS*.
revision: The Power Electronic Bridge (PEB) shall deliver a continuous short-circuit current of at least 225 amperes through the electric machine when connected to either the lower or upper Active Knee Switch (AKS), as verified by a test lasting 1 second under rated voltage conditions.

label: ok
original: The contractor shall prepare proposals how higher short circuit currents during AKS can be achieved.
revision: The contractor shall develop a technical proposal detailing specific design modifications or operational parameters required to increase the available short-circuit current at the AKS busbar by at least 10% relative to the baseline case, with the analysis validated using an approved electromagnetic transient simulation model and documented in a formal report submitted for review.

label: ok
original: Reduced switching losses during active short circuit (high side and as well low side) shall be considered correctly by the thermal model and shall be reflected in the power loss calculation and the maximum current calculation.
revision: The thermal model shall accurately account for reduced switching losses occurring during active short-circuit conditions on both the high-side and low-side switches; consequently, these losses must be incorporated into the total power loss calculation and used to determine the maximum allowable current.

label: ok
original: All internal and external Sensor- / Actuator-Input / Output signals shall be monitored for short circuit to ground, to battery and for open load.
revision: The system shall detect and flag a fault condition within 10 milliseconds if any internal or external sensor input or actuator output signal exhibits a voltage level indicating a short circuit to ground, a short circuit to the power supply rail, or an open-circuit condition exceeding the specified threshold.

label: ok
original: The input and output channels are to be designed in a way that they are protected against short circuits which might be caused by measurement procedures and operating voltage.
revision: The system shall detect and isolate any short-circuit condition occurring on input or output channels within 10 milliseconds of the fault onset, where the fault is induced by either external measurement equipment connections or internal operating voltages exceeding nominal limits by more than 10%.

label: ok
original: A short circuit is detected if the filtered backup battery voltage is below a certain level:
revision: The system shall detect a short-circuit condition when the filtered backup battery voltage falls below 2.0 V for a duration of at least 10 ms, provided that the input filter bandwidth is less than or equal to 1 kHz.

label: ok
original: If theres a short circuit in the backup battery path (BackupShortCirctuit equal 1), the test sequence is aborted in any state and the following values are set:
revision: If a short circuit occurs in the backup battery path, indicated by the signal BackupShortCircuit being TRUE, the test sequence shall be immediately aborted regardless of the current system state, and the following variables shall be assigned specific values: [insert specific variable assignments here].

label: ok
original: Exception: PN14_BackupRelay_Rq is set to 2 (open) while a short circuit in the backup battery path occurs (BackupShortCircuit equal 1)
revision: PN14_BackupRelay_Rq shall be set to 2 (open) when BackupShortCircuit equals 1, indicating a short circuit in the backup battery path.

label: ok
original: To detect a short circuit to VCC the following failure detection has to be implemented:
revision: The system shall detect a short circuit between any output pin and the VCC supply rail within 50 milliseconds of the fault occurrence, provided that the fault current exceeds 1 mA.

label: ok
original: If the backup battery is fully discharged, has an internal short circuit or an external short circuit occurs the backup relay must never be closed.
revision: The backup relay shall remain in the open state if any of the following conditions are met: the backup battery voltage is below the minimum threshold for full charge, an internal short circuit is detected within the backup battery, or an external short circuit occurs across the backup battery terminals.

label: ok
original: In Lithium mode, there is no need of backup battery charge control, decouople relay diagnosis, backup relay diagnosis, short circuit detection in backup path or relay cycle counters.
revision: In Lithium mode, the system shall not perform backup battery charge control, decoupled relay diagnosis, backup relay diagnosis, short-circuit detection in the backup path, or increment/decrement operations on relay cycle counters.

label: ok
original: If no falling edge occurrs a short circuit to VCC may be the reason or the driver has left the car.
revision: If no falling edge is detected within the specified timeout period, the system shall log an error indicating either a short circuit to VCC or that the driver has disconnected the device from the vehicle power supply.

label: ok
original: On a short circuit an engine start will follow, if the driver has left the car a falling edge ignition accessory will follow:
revision: If a short circuit occurs and the driver has exited the vehicle (detected by the door open signal or seatbelt status), the system shall initiate an automatic engine start sequence within 5 seconds of detecting the short circuit condition.

label: ok
original: Short circuit and open-load detection of the output M:Acoustic Locking ACK fault code, set / reset requirement: tbd.
revision: The system shall detect a short-circuit or open-load condition on the M:Acoustic Locking output and generate an "ACK" fault code; the mechanism to set and clear this fault code shall be implemented via a dedicated input signal that transitions from inactive to active for a duration of at least 10 milliseconds.

label: ok
original: As example, a zero-power consumption flags a non-connected cable, a high power consumption a short circuit in the cable or the active antenna element.
revision: If the measured power consumption of the cable assembly is less than 0.1 W, the system shall flag a "non-connected cable" status; if the measured power consumption exceeds 5.0 W, the system shall flag a "short circuit" status for either the cable or the active antenna element.

label: ok
original: A short circuit to terminal 30 or terminal 31 or a wire break on one microphone input shall not impact the functionality of the other microphone input.
revision: When a short circuit occurs between terminal 30 and terminal 31, or when an open circuit (wire break) occurs in one microphone input channel, the system shall maintain full operational functionality of the remaining unaffected microphone input channel without degradation of performance or loss of signal integrity.

label: ok
original: Each microphone input shall tolerate a short circuit to terminal 30 for at least 1 minutes ute.
revision: Each microphone input shall withstand a short circuit between the input line and terminal 30 for a duration of at least 60 seconds without failure, where "failure" is defined as any deviation from nominal operation or permanent damage to the input circuitry.

label: ok
original: Each microphone input shall tolerate a permanent short circuit to terminal 31.
revision: Each microphone input shall withstand a permanent short circuit between terminal 31 and ground for a duration of at least 24 hours without exhibiting functional degradation, physical damage, or thermal failure exceeding 85°C.

original: - The wheelspeed sensor signal line has a Short to Ubatt.
revision: The wheelspeed sensor signal line shall not exhibit a short circuit condition between the signal pin and the vehicle battery positive terminal (UBatt) under all operating conditions, including vibration, thermal cycling, and mechanical stress as defined in the environmental test specification.

label: ok

revision: The wheelspeed sensor supply line shall not exhibit a short circuit to ground under normal operating conditions and after exposure to specified environmental stress tests as defined in [Reference Document ID].

revision: The system shall detect and report a diagnostic fault if the temperature sensor input exhibits any of the following conditions: an open circuit, a short circuit to battery voltage, a short circuit to ground, a signal value below the defined lower threshold, or a signal value above the defined upper threshold.

original: Description: Voltage threshold for Charger Coupler Temperature Sensor Short to Ground.

label: ok

revision: The system shall detect and report a diagnostic fault if any of the following conditions are present on the LED output circuit: an open-circuit condition, a short circuit to battery voltage, a short circuit to ground, or a general electrical anomaly exceeding defined thresholds.

revision: The AHR output shall support continuous open-circuit diagnostics and shall detect short-to-battery or short-to-ground conditions within 10 milliseconds of system initialization, reporting a diagnostic fault status via the defined communication interface.

revision: The device shall provide permanent protection for all four USB interface pins (D+, D-, VBus, and GND) against short circuits to ground and against overvoltage conditions up to the maximum rated USB VBus voltage, ensuring that no damage occurs under these fault conditions as verified by applying specified test voltages and currents.

revision: The contractor shall implement all DSRC functionalities defined in document "Feature List Telematic5.STAR1 HU High Dedicated Short Range Communication" [RD 3539] for the Telematic5@Star1 HU.
